theme_and_archetype.theme: Light Primary (Dark mode supported but secondary)
theme_and_archetype.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4) fused with Apple/Crystal Glassmorphism
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Premium fintech, Notion/Figma-style minimalism, calm, trustworthy, zero nautical clichés.
core_principles: Clarity over decoration: Every element must explain itself.
Apple-like subtleties: Generous whitespace, continuous curve approximations (squircles), refined typography.
Notion-like utility: Slide-over panels, inline actions, completely out-of-the-way navigation.

font_family.primary: 'Geist', 'Manrope', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

sidebar.style: Notion-like. Flush with the left edge, subtle gray background (#F5F5F7). No heavy borders. Active states use white background with subtle shadow and primary text color.
sidebar.behavior: Collapsible to icons. Houses main navigation and quick 'Settings' access at the bottom.

topbar.style: Apple-like glassmorphism. sticky top-0, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FBFBFD]/80. 1px solid bottom border (border-[#E5E5EA]/50).
topbar.elements: Global Search (⌘+K), Notification Bell, User Avatar.

kpi_cards.style: White background, rounded-2xl, 1px subtle border. High-contrast large numbers, small colored trend pills (+5% / -2%).
kpi_cards.layout: Title top-left, Icon top-right (subtle gray), Value bottom-left, Trend bottom-right.

data_tables.style: Linear-style. No vertical borders. 1px horizontal borders (#E5E5EA). Hover effect on rows (bg-[#F5F5F7]/50). Sticky header with #FAFAFA background.
data_tables.features: Density toggle, customizable columns, action menu (ellipsis) at the end of each row. Row clicks open Slide-over.

slide_over_panels.usage: Used for all forms (+Borç, +Alacak, +Ödeme) and detail views. Replaces traditional modals.
slide_over_panels.style: shadcn/ui Sheet component. right-side. rounded-l-3xl. bg-white. Overlay is backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/10.
slide_over_panels.header: Sticky header with Close (ESC) button on top right, Title on left.

status_badges.style: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), soft background, bold colored text, 1px border. E.g., 'Onay Bekliyor' -> Warning semantic colors.

empty_states.style: Figma/Notion style. Centered content in a dashed-border box or highly padded area. Friendly, monochromatic line-art illustration (Lucide icons scaled up to 48px/64px with stroke-1). Clear, single CTA button.

charts.style: Minimal. No grid lines or very faint horizontal only (stroke-dasharray='3 3' stroke='#E5E5EA'). Clean tooltips with rounded corners and shadows.
charts.colors: Monochromatic or dual-tone based on primary palette. E.g., Nakit Akışı uses Primary Black (#111111) and Secondary Gray (#86868B).

toast_notifications.style: Apple-like detached floating pills. White bg, soft shadow, semantic icon.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Micro-lift for cards: hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-200.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Loading skeletons (animate-pulse bg-[#E5E5EA]) instead of spinners for data fetching.

iconography.rules: Consistent stroke width (1.5px for UI elements, 1px for large empty states). Use monochromatic icons. No filled icons unless representing an active state.

testing_guidelines.data_testid_rule: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, table rows, dropdown items, tabs) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
testing_guidelines.justification: Required for robust E2E testing (Playwright/Cypress) to prevent breakages during style updates.
